what_it_does: Deepak Nitrite manufactures and sells a diversified portfolio of advanced intermediates, phenolics, fluorochemicals, and advanced materials to various industries globally. It generates revenue through the production and sale of these chemical products, targeting domestic and international markets.
other_facts: Consolidated revenue stood at 7887 Crores for FY 2025-26 with domestic revenues of 6703 Crores and exports of 1184 Crores.
Employed over 2800 personnel including contract workers across operations, projects, and support functions as of March 31, 2026.
Estimated market share of more than 50% in India for Phenol and Acetone.
